stories.headline: Anthropic raises a further $12.2B from the greenshoe, taking its IPO total to $93.5B

facts.text: Underwriters exercised the greenshoe overallotment, raising an additional $12.2B; total raised in the IPO is $93.5B.
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC RAISES AN ADDITIONAL $12.2B AS UNDERWRITERS EXERCISE THEIR “GREENSHOE” OVERALLOTMENT OF SHARES, BRINGING THE TOTAL RAISED IN ITS IPO TO $93.5B

facts.text: Stock closed down 8.5% at $88.91 on its second day of trading; IPO price was $83.

stories.headline: Staff describe decades of abusive behaviour by Jensen Huang; Nvidia settled with two senior leaders
stories.quote: CURRENT AND EX-STAFFERS DESCRIBE ABUSIVE BEHAVIOR BY JENSEN HUANG THAT GOES BACK DECADES; NVIDIA SETTLED WITH TWO SENIOR LEADERS WHO ALLEGED ABUSIVE CONDUCT

facts.text: Sources: the board's main reason for ousting Huang was 'lying' and 'lack of candor' over the Alice Huang affair.
facts.quote: SOURCES: NVIDIA BOARD'S MAIN REASON FOR OUSTING JENSEN HUANG WAS HIS “LYING” AND “LACK OF CANDOR” FROM OCTOBER 2025 UNTIL THIS FALL OVER THE ALICE HUANG AFFAIR

facts.text: Trump says he would love to see Huang return as CEO.
facts.quote: TRUMP SAYS HE “WOULD LOVE TO SEE” JENSEN HUANG RETURN AS CEO, SAYING “IF THEY WERE SMART”, NVIDIA WOULD “ACCEPT AN APOLOGY, AND LET HIM GO BACK TO WORK”

stories.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis and posts the proof in Lean
stories.quote: ANTHROPIC MATHEMATICIAN LEVENT ALPÖGE CLAIMS HE USED CLAUDE TO PROVE THE 167-YEAR-OLD RIEMANN HYPOTHESIS AND POSTS THE PROOF IN THE LEAN PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE

stories.headline: US SEC is probing Nvidia's accounting practices, sources say
stories.quote: SOURCES: THE US SEC IS PROBING NVIDIA'S ACCOUNTING PRACTICES; LAST YEAR, NVIDIA CHANGED HOW IT REPORTS REVENUE, REMOVING SINGAPORE FROM GEOGRAPHICAL BREAKDOWNS

facts.text: California's AG subpoenaed Nvidia over whether Huang's actions resulted in China getting advanced chips and whether Nvidia misled investors.
facts.quote: CALIFORNIA'S AG SUBPOENAS NVIDIA TO INVESTIGATE WHETHER JENSEN HUANG'S ACTIONS RESULTED IN CHINA GETTING ADVANCED CHIPS, AND WHETHER NVIDIA MISLED INVESTORS

stories.headline: Nvidia shares closed down 14% on Friday, a seventh straight fall; Nasdaq 100 fell 5.6%

facts.text: Nasdaq 100 fell 5.6% on Friday and 10.4% for the week, its worst run in more than six years.
facts.quote: NASDAQ 100 FELL 5.6% ON FRIDAY, TAKING ITS LOSS FOR THE WEEK TO 10.4%, ITS WORST RUN IN MORE THAN SIX YEARS, AMID FEARS OF A SLOWDOWN IN THE AI INVESTMENT BOOM
